summary: Fulcrum Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a merger agreement with Slate Medicines, where Fulcrum's subsidiary acquires Slate via a two-step merger (reverse subsidiary forward). The all-stock consideration uses an exchange ratio. Post-close, pre-merger Slate stockholders (excluding Investors) hold ~55.9%, Investors ~39.1%, and pre-merger Fulcrum holders ~5.0% of the combined company, with a concurrent investment noted. The merger is intended as a tax-free reorganization. No price per share or premium is disclosed. Fulcrum is the acquirer and Slate the target, with the deal structured as a stock-for-stock reverse merger. Watch for regulatory approvals, closing conditions, and investor reaction to dilution.
